releases.name: PrivyLock 1.0.1
releases.notes: Universal arm64 + x86_64 macOS build for macOS 12 or later. Ad-hoc signed for distribution while Apple Developer membership is unavailable; Gatekeeper may require the user to approve the first launch.

releases.name: PrivyLock 1.0.0
releases.notes:
First public release of PrivyLock, a native macOS menu-bar app locker.

- Protect selected apps with Touch ID or Mac login password fallback.
- Enforce locks across app launches with watchdog coverage.
- See protected app icons, identifiers, and lock state at a glance.
- Includes the signed macOS app bundle: PrivyLock-macOS.zip.
